notes.title: Clara Wraiths is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017057/80baff4cf88c324274ed44ef78e8381df887e8d8.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

The wait is over! I am proudly presenting my new title called Clara Wraiths which is now available on Steam! If you are into 2D horror games, this might be the game for you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3922110/Clara_Wraiths/

Check out this horror games bundle if you are interested:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43332/Indie_Horror_Games_Bundle_3/

Check out my previous release, Zereoton Hauntings:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3856190/Zereoton_Hauntings/

Please give this game a try. Your feedback is valuable to me. So, please let me know if you encounter issues.


Thanks to everyone who have been supporting me on Steam! Creating and releasing this game on Steam would have never been possible without your support.

I hope you will enjoy the game. Happy Gaming!

Best Regards,
Anamik
